## [R-452 conditional history-resolvent recurrence envelope] - 2026-08-31

Added R-452 as a claim-nonbearing T-054 analytic interface. The exact one-step history recurrence has a finite resolvent with separate nonresonant and resonant branches; the inherited parent decay gives the sufficient owner threshold kappa<1. Primary, independent, hostile, integrated and Lean checks pass. The source-owned recurrence, coefficient, common domain, exhaustion, common-alpha, physical and continuum obligations remain open, and the existing forward and observation-first inverse methods are unchanged.

## [R-453 defect-stable history-resolvent] - 2026-08-31

Added R-453 as an additive T-054 analytic interface downstream of R-452. A nonnegative residual in the unchanged one-step history recurrence contributes the exact step-indexed convolution sum kappa^(R-j) delta_j; a geometric residual bound gives the second resolvent D*S_R(kappa,s), with separate resonant branches and sufficient threshold kappa<1 and s<1. Primary 29752/29752, independent 14827/14827, hostile 14/14, integrated 19/19 and Lean R453 pass. The source-owned recurrence, residual, common domain, exhaustion, common-alpha, physical and continuum obligations remain open. Existing T-054, T-059 and T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged; no tier change, negative result or PDF.
